Yɛmpɛ sɛ yɛka kyerɛ wo, yɛmpɛ sɛ yɛka kyerɛ wo, (sɛ nea yɛrebɛka no yɛ nokware)

Sɛnea ɛyɛɛ koraa sɛ 'KRAMAN, kraman no, ntumi nnya awie wɔ ne ɔkɔkɔn mu'

Kwasia Kraman bi wɔ hɔ, na ama ne ɔkɔkɔkɔn nyinaa nti, ɔanni obaa bi (ne kuro mu) a ɔbɛyɛ ne yere. Enti ɔkɔɔ kurow bi mu kɔhwehwɛ obaa a ɔbɛyɛ ne yere. (Ɔwaree, na ɔde no baa ne kuro mu.) Ɔne ne yere tenaa hɔ (beaou), a ɔbaa no kɔɔ ne kuro mu. Akyi no, ne  Ne aseayɛfoɔ took ne gun kɔɔ kwae kɔtoo mpaboa kwan so sɛ ɔre prepare Dog no aba. Nnansa a ɛkyerɛe no, Dog no kɔɔ hɔ, na berɛ a ɔkɔe no, ɔhunuu sɛ mpaboa nam wɔ gya so, wɔ abaayɛn hɔ. Berɛ a anadwo bae no, ɔne ne yere kɔɔ kɔhyɛɛ nna. Kraman repue kɔtumi nsuo, na ɔhunuu nam a ne nnamtwe repere gya no mu. Kraman no san bae na ɔkɔdae, na ɔde ne ti too hua no so (na ɔdae) na ɔhwɛɛ nam noi yiye. Ɛnnɛ, nam no nka baa ne nsa; ɔyɛɛ biara sɛ ɔbɛgyina mu, nanso ɔantumi. Oh! ɔsɔree na ɔkɔɔ baabi a nam no hyɛe; ɔnam guu no nyinaa, na ɔsan bae na ɔdae. Anɔpa a ɛdi so no, berɛ a nnoɔma baa hɔ, berɛ a ne yere repue kɔre kɔtɔ, ɔhwehwɛɛ nam no, nanso nam biara nnim hɔ. Ne yere see, "O, maame! o, maame! obi apue nam no nyinaa." Berɛ a Kraman tee eyi no, ne nsoɔyɛ bɔɔ no (yehwene), na ɔfaa ne ntoma hwee ne ti, na ɔda hɔ dwo. Ɛna mprenu puda koro mu no, ɔsɔree na ɔhyɛɛ kwan no so; ɔdwene kɔɔ ne kuro, na ɔka amanneɛ no, sɛnea ɔkɔɔ hɔ kɔtwee ne akukuu nam, na sɛnea animguase kɔɔ ne nso mu, na sɛnea, ɛnti, ɔrekɔ hwehwɛ obi a ɔwɔ owuo-aduro a ɛyɛ ɔsarfoɔ, na ama wɔnka bi ma no. Nnipa no see, "Adanko, ɔkraman no, wɔ adeɛ a ɛyɛ den paa, paa, paa (aduro)." Kraman no hyɛɛ aseɛ, na ɔyɛɛ ntɛm kɔɔ ɔkraman no kuro mu. Ɔse, "Papa Bosom, me tutu ba wo nkyɛn sɛ wobotue me; me yɛ korɔfo, korɔfo, korɔfo, na wɔse wowo aduro (a ɛyɛ nnawututu) a ɛyɛ saa, enti mebɔ wo mpae, ma me kakra, na sε ɛyɛ sika bɛnara a, mɛsoa." Bosom no hyɛɛ no ase sɛ, "Ɛyɛ nokware sɛ mewɔ bi, enti kɔfa nnaman nam baakyerɛ mma me."

Kraman no kɔɔ kuro bi mu kɔtoo nan baako ma sika kɔkɔɔ domafa mu (3s. 6d.) na ɔde baa. Okraman no no paa no, na ɔtwaa no, na ɔde hyɛɛ nnuaba nketewa so, na ɔtɔɔ mako ne nnuane ne sɔre, na ɔde hwee mu, na ɔde guu gya so. Berɛ a gya no bɔɔ no, nnipa kakra akyi no, ɔkasae (Kraman) tee sɛ ɛrepopopi, hyee, e e e! Kraman hwɛɛ no mmerɛ pii. Ɛnnɛ na ɔnwura no kaa sɛ, "Kraman, kɔ kɔda adeefie mu baako, na me nso mɛkɔ ada ebi foforo mu, na ɔkyena anɔpa, mɛfa saa nam yi afiri (gya no so) na meye aduro ama wo." Kraman kɔdae. Ɔnwura no nso kɔdae. Ɛnnɛ Kraman no dae, ɔdae (nanso ɔntumi anka), na nnamfo no nkaaba baa ne nose mu, nanso wanka biara. Afei ɔhwee bio. Ɔse, "Papa Bosom." Bosom no ayɛ no mmuae se, "Aane!" Ɔse, "Mice wɔ wo kuro mu, enti merekɔ gyina nam no, na mede aba me nkyɛn." Bosom no se, "Kɔfa; m'asɛm nyinaa ne sɛ m'ani bɛka no ɔkyena, na matumi ayɛ aduro ama wo." Enti Kraman no kɔfaa. Afei Kraman no da hɔ. Ɔse, "Papa Hare." Ɔyɛɛ no mmuae se, "Aane!" Ɔse, "Mice no bɛnam so atwe, enti mɛde akɔatwa m'atifi ase na mɛkɔda." Hare no se, "Nea m'adwene mu wɔ ne sɛ ɔkyena, sɛ nneɛma nyinaa ba pɛpɛɛpɛ a, mɛde bɛyɛ aduro ama wo." Kraman no tɔɔ ne ho ase bio; ɛnna sɛnea ɔpɛ sɛ ɔyɛ a, ɔantumi anka ne ho. Ɔse, "Papa Hare, saa mmoa nketese yi aba me mmoa a ɛwɔ me mpaaso ase yi mu, enti mɛfa nam no akɔto me tiwuo, na mɛgyina hɔ kosi sɛ nneɛma bɛyɛ hɔ." Hare no hyɛɛ aseɛ sɛ, "O, meka kyerɛ wo, nea ɛhia me ne sɛ mɛnya (nam no) ɔkyena na maka aduro ama wo." Kraman no faa nam no too ne tiwuo, na ɔgyinaa hɔ. Ɛna nsuo ketennu firi nnaman no mu tɔɔ ne anim, na ɔnam ne tongue nwenei. Ɔsee, "O, Agya Hare, sɛ nnam yi ho a, saa mmoa nketewa no ayɛ me so, na wɔaba me ti so, enti mɛfa (nnam no) akura me anom." Hare no hyɛɛ no ase sɛ, "Oho o!" "Meka kyerɛ wo sɛ ɔkyena, sɛ nneɛma nyinaa ba pɛpɛɛpɛ a, mɛyɛ aduro a ɛfiri mu ama wo." Seesei ɛyɛ den wɔ ne anomu, na ɔnam dan no mu mpɔtwee; ɔkɔtɔ ne ntade (ne nne bɔɔ), fre! fre! fre! Ɔse, "Papa Hare, ma me nnyɛ wo ayaresɛm wɔ ei nam yi ho." Hare no aseɛ sɛ, "Dɛn nti na wopɛ sɛ woyɛ me ayaresɛn ho?" Kraman no hyɛɛ aseɛ sɛ, "Me kyerɛ sɛ, sene sɛ saa mmoa nketese yi bɛdi no, ma me mma wo sika." Hare no se, "Aane, ɛnyɛ saa! Ma ɔkyena anɔpa mma." O! nanso seesei Kraman no ma (nam no) kɔe (ne kɔn mu). Ɛnna ɔtɔɔ fam na ɔdae. Anɔpa a ɛdi so no, anɔpa anɔpa paa, ɔKraman see, "Kraman, fa saa nam no mma me." Kraman no hyɛɛ no ase sɛ, "Ho, Agya Kraman, adɛn nti, woante nea mekaee wo nnawɔtwe a ɛtwere no, sɛ mɛgye wo nsa (nam no ho)?" ɔKraman no hyɛɛ no ase sɛ, "Ɛnna woadi no?" Kraman no see, "Aane! Madi no, efisɛ mebuyee no." ɔKraman no see, "Wo, Kraman, 'owu' a wɔfrɛ no 'owu' no rennya wo kwan."

Me nsɛm a meka yi, sɛ ɛyɛ dɛ, (anaasɛ) sɛ ɛnyɛ dɛ a, fa bi kɔ bam, na ma bi mma me.
